coverage: Verified candidate file sha256 hashes match packet artifacts (rc_filter.kicad_pcb, rc_filter.kicad_sch, requirements.txt)

Independently parsed the native board file and applied the stated >=0.20 mm criterion to all 5 saved copper track segments: all are 0.25 mm, zero violations (review-work/circuit/experiments/track_width_check.out)
Cross-checked track endpoints against all 7 pad centers and the /OUT T-junction geometry (review-work/circuit/experiments/connectivity_check.out)
Verified saved B.Cu GND zone fill continuity: via (113,100) inside copper, J1 pad 3 joined by four 45-degree thermal spokes, no /IN bridging (review-work/circuit/experiments/thermal_spoke_check.out)

Manually derived rotated schematic pin positions for J1/R1/C1 and confirmed net assignment (/IN, /OUT, GND) matches work/netlist/design.xml; topology is a valid RC low-pass (fc ~159 Hz, no performance spec stated)
Re-ran kicad-cli 10.0.7 ERC and DRC (with schematic parity) on the candidate; both clean, reproducing packet evidence (review-work/circuit/experiments/drc_rerun.json, erc_rerun.json)
Checked via, zone min_thickness, and edge/courtyard placement against stated conditions

findings.condition: The packet's geometry criterion has empty params and the check summary states 'saved-board geometry extracted (no declared geometric requirement applied)' with outcome 'info'. The >=0.20 mm track-width requirement from inputs/requirements.txt was therefore never evaluated by the automated check; only raw widths were dumped.

evidence.locator: tracks[] width_mm fields; file contains no requirement/threshold evaluation

findings.mechanism: A reader relying on check outcomes alone would see no pass/fail verdict for the sole stated requirement; an undersized segment would not have been flagged by this pipeline configuration.
findings.reasoning: This is a verification-coverage gap in the supplied checks, not a design defect: I independently parsed the native board file and applied the stated 0.20 mm threshold; all 5 saved copper track segments are 0.25 mm, so the candidate complies with the requirement. No blocking allegation is warranted; recorded as info so the adjudicator knows the criterion verdict rests on reviewer measurement rather than the packaged geometry check.
findings.title: Geometry criterion was not machine-adjudicated in supplied evidence (independent check confirms compliance)

limitations: Zone fill evaluated as saved; the read-only candidate forbids a refill pass, so fill correctness is per the stored filled_polygon only
No SPICE simulation performed: requirements.txt states no electrical performance requirement, so filter response was only sanity-derived (fc ~159 Hz), not verified against any spec
Ampacity and fabrication-capability assessment intentionally omitted per the explicit exclusion in inputs/requirements.txt
ERC re-run used embedded schematic symbols without the stock library env overrides; result (0 violations) matched the packet run regardless
